title: Marguerite and the Spire
author: Gideon Kavanagh
blurb: Felix Coldharbour, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
